_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Ndingu ya siku - Ngolo zisambula: {dice_summary}
Ngolo zaku zisambula: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Omutu {current_player_id} uta ombela! Ondjala ya tala {face_value} ni {count}, iyawo ni ndogo kuliko {quantity}.
Omutu {loser_id} (omutu wa ombela pamberi) okwa kosa osita.
call.caller_loses:
Omutu {current_player_id} uta ombela! Ondjala ya tala {face_value} ni {count}, iyawo ni >= {quantity}.
Omutu {loser_id} (ombeli) okwa kosa osita.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Oku ci linga, ka ca sukilile olombongo.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kuluta kwakala sikwata kukena kwa '[Bid: X, Y]' okwa '[Call]'. Kuluta kwakala: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Iwingi ipya {new_quantity} ni ndogo kuliko iyawo {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Wolwela wa tala ipya {new_face_value} ni ndogo kuliko iyawo {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Oku landa kuaco ku sokisiwa loku landisa ovina volovenda.
bid_reason.face_range: Wolwela wa tala ufele uve kati ya 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Mukwata {player_id} wa sambulwa na kuluta kwakala.
